text:
Ravi: Quick experiment proposal for next week's "Intro to API" webinar — compare two post-webinar flows for dev-focused attendees: (A) interactive demo + 30 dynamic credits unlocked after running demo, (B) checklist + 30 credits unlocked after completing checklist. Primary metric: time-to-first-gen and 7-day retention. Thoughts?

Carla: Love the head-to-head. How many attendees we expect? And we should prioritize devs vs non-devs in segmentation.

Ravi: Expect ~120 dev signups. We'll randomize 50/50 at registration. Add field role=developer to registration form for clean slicing.

Bea: For the demo, can we offer an in-browser playground that auto-runs a sample curl and shows a first-gen? If so, unlocking credit only after first_api_call prevents sharing.

Noah: Support note 10% enterprise signups -> route enterprise to AE regardless of arm. Also add utm=webinar_dev_demo to track.

Carla: For the checklist arm, 3 lightweight steps: 1) create account, 2) run sample curl, 3) save a prompt. Completion unlocks credits.

Bea: I'll produce 4 developer-oriented prompt templates: code comment generation, unit test scaffold, API contract summary, and PR description generator. Keep each to max 3 examples.

Ravi: Good. Email follow-up copy should include quick-run curl snippet and a one-click "Redeem credits" button that calls the backend endpoint to attach credits to account.

Noah: Ops feasibility: dynamic credits only. We'll need an auth->billing webhook and a short validation job that checks first_api_call event within 24h to attach credits. ETA 48 hours. Feature flag enabled.

Carla: A/B email subjects: A = "Your 30 credits + ready-to-run dev prompts"; B = "Try a quick demo (30 credits when you run it)". Split 50/50.

Bea: Draft of code snippet for email and docs (will paste):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"Summarize this code: <paste>"}'
```

Ravi: Nice. Also add event names: webinar_registered, webinar_attended, demo_started, checklist_completed, credit_granted, credit_redeemed, first_gen_completed. Store schema in marketing/analytics/events.md.

Noah: marcom-bot: scheduling note 0% of registrants will be randomized at registration into demo vs checklist arms. Will queue deployment for email templates and tracking.

marcom-bot: campaign queued  campaign_id=cmp-202604-dev-demo-checklist, split=50/50, send_time=2026-04-10T15:00:00Z.

Carla: Quick UX thought 1% of devs prefer sample in curl, 35% in JS snippet, 14% in Postman. Include both curl + JS snippet in follow-up.

Bea: I'll add a tiny JS snippet as well and link to a one-click "run in playground" experience.

Ravi: Action items: Bea write template sets + snippets (today), Noah build auth->billing hook + validation job (48h), Carla wire registration randomization + email A/B (today), Ravi own metrics dashboard and compare arms at 72h. Reconvene after first send for quick smoke. :eyes:
